run_cpplint_on_cpp_file: run cpplint on a C++ source file to check Google C++ style compliance
run_cpplint_with_filters: run cpplint with custom filters like --filter=-whitespace,+build/include_order on C++ files
run_cpplint_verbose_mode: run cpplint in verbose mode with --verbose=5 to show all confidence level errors
review_cpp_include_order: review a C++ header file for proper include order using cpplint include state tracking
review_cpp_header_guard: review a C++ header file for correct header guard style using cpplint
